messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 1716123456 — Elevated 5xx/timeouts on /v1/generate across europe-region. P50 latency spike and head-of-line queueing observed in batcher. Paging on-call: @Maya Patel.
Maya Patel: I’m on it. joining bridge in 2. grabbing logs.
Jordan Lee: I see a surge of large-token requests (avg seq_len 1024) causing batching scheduler backlog — queues are hitting max_batches_per_worker. Seeing KV cache pressure too. :thinking_face:
Maya Patel: ok quick triage — is this a single model or multicast? any recent deploys?
deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-15T09:12Z: model-llama-4q-v0.9 rolled to prod canary (5% traffic). No rollback.
Maya Patel: noted. Jordan — can we snapshot the queue sizes and hot-worker ids? paste /bin/queue-stats output.
Jordan Lee: running now.
Jordan Lee: ```
queue-stats --region eu-west-1 --top=10
worker-7: queues=312 pending_batches=78 avg_wait_ms=1450
worker-3: queues=290 pending_batches=64 avg_wait_ms=1380
worker-11: queues=15 pending_batches=2 avg_wait_ms=120
``` 
Jordan Lee: cluster-level batcher limit = 300 batches/worker. We're over threshold on two workers — head-of-line blocking obvious.
Maya Patel: symptoms match: gateway 5xxs and upstream timeouts when requests hit saturated workers and are evicted.
Rachel Gomez: adding context from gateway: most 5xx are 504 timeouts from inference-gateway -> -> batcher rpc timeout 30s. Error rate ~8% for last 10m. Customer-facing impact: degradation for interactive chat sessions; some long requests failing.
Sam - Support: customers P1 tickets: 3 reported degraded replies, one enterprise customer on Dedicated reported timeouts. They're asking for ETA.
Maya Patel: immediate mitigations: 1) enable temporary throttling on high-token routes 2) enable overflow-routing to fallback-model (smaller quantized) 3) evict oldest pending batches on hotspot workers 4) rollback canary if correlated.
Jordan Lee: suggest commands:
```bash
# throttle route
redwoodctl routes update /v1/generate --rate-limit 50rps --region eu-west-1
# enable overflow routing to model-llama-4q-compact
redwoodctl routing set-overflow --from model-llama-4q-v0.9 --to model-llama-4q-compact --region eu-west-1
# evict oldest batches on worker-7
redwoodctl worker evict --worker worker-7 --policy oldest --count 100
``` 
Maya Patel: executing throttle and overflow now.
Maya Patel: `redwoodctl routes update` success — throttling set to 50rps. Overflow routing enabled.
ops-bot: Route update event: throttling applied by Maya Patel at 09:25:42Z
ops-bot: Routing event: overflow set to model-llama-4q-compact at 09:26:10Z
Jordan Lee: evicting batches on worker-7/3 now.
Jordan Lee: eviction completed — freed ~600 pending requests across both workers, avg wait back to 120ms on next sample.
Rachel Gomez: metrics update: 5xx dropped from 8% -> 1.4% in 3 minutes, p50 latency dropped 30%.
Sam - Support: relaying to affected customers: telling them we applied routing and throttles, investigating root cause, will follow up.
Maya Patel: decision: keep throttling & overflow for 30m, monitor, prepare canary rollback if error recurs.
Jordan Lee: root hypotheses: 1) workload spike with many long-seq requests; 2) new canary increases per-request compute and KV cache misses; 3) scheduling heuristic didn't rebalance across workers fast enough.
Rachel Gomez: follow-ups: - increase scheduler rebalance frequency - add per-request seq_len guard to early-batch-split - add alert for queue depth per-worker > 200
Maya Patel: assigning actions: Jordan — implement temporary rebalance tweak & eviction automation. Rachel — open infra PR for alerts and seq_len guard. Sam — coordinate customer comms. I'll monitor and update.
Maya Patel: on-call handoff in 45 mins to Jordan. tagging for escalation if errors >5% again.
Jordan Lee: taking handoff at 10:10Z. I'll keep monitoring dashboards and be ready to rollback canary.
Maya Patel: closing the live mitigation channel — we'll keep thread updated. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident 1716123456 — mitigation applied. Current status: degraded -> stabilizing. Next update in 15m. :information_source:
